text.insert: The knowledge lane connects worker results and external sources to one shared per-game knowledge base. Importers and the summarizer job record material; the librarian proposes semantic changes and the apply layer validates and writes them. Later workers read the resulting records.
. Worker summarization and librarian consumption are independent opt-in lanes, both off by default. Their queues and write contracts are different.

steps.text: Collect worker results when --worker-summary is enabled
Enqueue a deduplicated worker_summary job for a closed worker state; startup catches closed states without a job.
The leased summarizer job runs the model over the transcript and deterministic checkpoint digest. Validate narrative fields against the exact submission set.

Commit worker_run, submission, run_narrative, the attempt watermark, and a run_closed index_task in one transaction. The model supplies narrative; scores and integration outcomes remain deterministic.
The summarizer processor uses concurrency 16, a 60-second lease, and a five-attempt ceiling. Missing targets or runs without a scored checkpoint or error signal can skip.
Import PR and Discord material through shared harness intake

During sync publication, repoint the canonical checkout before knowledge intake. Intake finishes before the publication boundary and dispatch release. Epoch boundaries also call intake after report recomputation.

Fetch merged-PR dumps into the archive with postmortem generation disabled. Against the selected checkout and report, reconcile identities, mechanically re-anchor unchanged code citations, then import PRs, Discord, and attempts.
PR import writes source and attributed pull_request rows and enqueues pr_imported. Discord import appends message rows and enqueues archival_ingest. Advance each source watermark.

Wiki import requires an explicit lane. Manual kg2-drift-scan can enqueue flagged subjects; accepted librarian follow-ups also enqueue drift_recheck. Source ingestion alone does not create semantic facts.
Drain index_task when --librarian-consumer is enabled or kg2-librarian runs
The run-loop lane polls every five seconds with concurrency four and pauses claims during active sync. Index tasks use started_at and done_at, separate from summarizer job leases.
Claim by pathway priority and FIFO. Split PR tasks over 24 attributed rows, drift batches over 12 subjects, and oversized archival slices before a model pass.
Build the current subject records, source material, head revision, and reading views. The librarian reads sources and returns a proposal; it has no writable store tool.
After two persisted task failures, split eligible multi-item tasks or abandon an unsplittable task with a warning. More than five consecutive pass failures abort a drain.
Validate and apply semantic proposals
Preview the proposal through the shared apply layer. Give rejected items one correction turn, then drop and log remaining rejected items.
Resolve subjects and evidence, enforce scope and pathway citation rules, and apply facts, evidence, links, and curated entities. Confirmed facts need no same-value rewrite.
Stamp every touched target and entities that received a fact or link. Accepted out-of-scope follow-ups enqueue later drift_recheck tasks.
Recheck flagged drift after PR, run-close, and drift passes. Release once if drift remains; complete with a recorded warning after the bounded retry.
Read and maintain the shared knowledge base
Later workers load target cards and query V2 records and source evidence. Worker edits and transcripts feed the next summary and librarian pass; workers never directly mutate semantic rows.
Source watermarks, task timestamps, subject indexing state, and citation revisions track progress. Search indexes and code-graph projections are derived stores with separate rebuild paths.

Operator-started kg2-backfill processes a ranked list of unstamped targets through the backfill librarian and the same apply layer. Its injected four-array schema and direct target list differ from the event-driven consumer.
Enabling the summarizer does not enable the librarian. A queued index task can remain pending until a consumer runs.
